async function hudClear(name,state){if(await page.evaluate(()=>innerWidth>480))return;await frames();const bounds=await page.evaluate(()=>{const stage=document.querySelector('.uf-stage'),chip=stage.querySelector('.uf-flight-chip'),phase=stage.querySelector('.uf-flight-phase'),lens=stage.querySelector('.uf-lens-controls'),region=stage.querySelector('.uf-flight-chip + .uf-chip'),rect=n=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect();return{left:r.left,right:r.right,top:r.top,bottom:r.bottom,width:r.width,height:r.height};},visible=n=>n&&getComputedStyle(n).display!=='none'&&n.getBoundingClientRect().width>0&&n.getBoundingClientRect().height>0;if(!visible(chip)||!visible(phase)||!visible(lens))return null;const a=rect(chip),p=rect(phase),b=rect(lens),intersects=(x,y)=>Math.max(x.left,y.left)<Math.min(x.right,y.right)&&Math.max(x.top,y.top)<Math.min(x.bottom,y.bottom);return{viewportWidth:innerWidth,stageWidth:stage.getBoundingClientRect().width,chip:a,phase:p,lens:b,chipText:chip.textContent,phaseText:phase.textContent,regionHidden:!visible(region),chipIntersectsLens:intersects(a,b),phaseIntersectsLens:intersects(p,b)};});if(!bounds)return;result.hudBounds.push({name,state,...bounds});save();assert.equal(bounds.regionHidden,true,'Phone flyby HUD reserves space for phase text');assert.equal(bounds.chipIntersectsLens,false,'Phone flyby badge stays clear of zoom controls');assert.equal(bounds.phaseIntersectsLens,false,'Phone flyby phase stays clear of zoom controls');}
